text.text_excerpt: Really enjoyed a Tuesday night dinner here. Truth be told we were headed to another Pho place but they were closed. Glad they were! Walked down Magazine and found Pho Noi Viet. Our server Kim was friendly and attentive, positive vibes coming off of her. We had Hot Green Tea and Spring Rolls. Two bowls of Pho. I had the Pho Ga and really enjoyed it, nice broth. I don't know why I had never been here before? They have delicious Pho and it is super reasonably priced. Worth checking out for sure.

My cousin and I checked this place out because I searched yelp for a Vietnamese restaurant and I had a taste for some Pho. This is a cool little restaurant. It was right off Magazine street where we were doing some shopping. We were seated immediately at a table and ordered the egg rolls and spring rolls. The spring rolls were delicious but the egg rolls were the best. We had two orders, don't judge. Get them and you will understand! We followed up the spring and egg rolls with chicken pho. The hint of jasmine was perfect. This has to be one of the best order of Pho I have ever had. The food tasted so fresh and the price was right. The staff put the icing on the cake. Came here on Tuesday night after going by Lilly's Cafe. They were closed, but online it said they were open. Hmmm... questionable?!? We were hungry for some Vietnamese food, so we saw that Pho Noi Viet was open and decided to try it out. We were immediately greeted by a lady, who was also checking out another customer, and she said, "please sit anywhere." She quickly came by our table once she was done and got our drink orders. We ordered a tofu spring rolls, shrimp bun, grilled pork bun, and chicken fried rice. We came in with mediocre expectations and were pleasantly surprised.
